caption: The video depicts a red toy sports car with white racing stripes across its hood and roof resting at an angle on the left of a translucent blue plastic tray. The tray lies on a cream quilted fabric, and faint scratch marks radiate across its floor. To the right of the car, a shallow puddle of clear liquid holds a smooth dome-shaped transparent object bearing a bright white highlight on top. A small separate droplet sits just to the right of the dome, distinct from it and from the reflections. Across the excerpt the car, dome, droplet, and puddle outline hold identical positions with no detectable displacement. The camera stays fixed, so the tray rim and fabric texture remain steady relative to the frame edges. Only negligible shimmer in the highlights hints at change, leaving the scene visually still throughout.
